messages.author: 4e956cc50ac3e075
messages.subject: Re: modeling subsets of all variables
parts:
Hi Jason,

If you want to compare different models, you can use some of the functionalities of the AICcmodavg package (model selection, multimodel inference, check GOF), as Marc Kéry suggested. However, you will have to write out each model that you want to compare. I intentionally did not include any functions to automagically generate all possible combinations of variables to steer users away from "fishing expeditions" and keep the number of models down. It is important to think about each model you want to include in your candidate model set and check the output of each model for potential problems (e.g., lack of convergence, parameters on boundaries, ill conditioning). Just looking at the resulting model selection table to see which model is best can be misleading.

Hope it helps,

Marc
